name: Utah

examVariants.label: Class D knowledge test (never previously licensed)

retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Same-day retake generally not allowed; return on a later day
retake.retakeFee: No additional knowledge-test fee within the same application in most offices (verify locally)

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-5 a.m. until age 18, unless accompanied by a licensed driver 21+ or driving for school, work, or an emergency
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 6 months, no passengers under 21 unless they are immediate family or a licensed driver 21+ is present

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (certified birth certificate or valid passport)
Two proofs of Utah residence (for a REAL ID card)
Proof of name change if applicable
process.realIdNotes: Utah issues REAL ID-compliant cards. Applicants must present proof of identity, one document with the SSN, and two proofs of Utah residence. Documents must be original or certified; photocopies are not accepted.
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 200 points in 3 years (age 21+); 70 points in 3 years (under 21)
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane if safe, or slow down, for stopped emergency, tow, and maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph in a marked school zone

verifyNote: Official DLD confirms the 50-question closed-book test for never-licensed applicants and the 25-question open-book test for previously licensed applicants, but its current written-test page does not publish the passing threshold for the 25-question variant; 20 correct is retained pending direct official confirmation.
